meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 让 Claude 帮你检查或设置 claude-mem 的云同步:查询本地 worker 的同步状态,或把 cmem.ai → Connect 给出的 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL 写进 ~/.claude-mem/settings.json,重启 worker 后验证能否连上 SyncHub。
howto.when: 当你提到「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」「cmem pro」等说法,或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到自己的 cmem.ai 账号时接管。

howto.what_en: Claude checks your claude-mem cloud sync status, or writes the token, user id, and SyncHub URL from cmem.ai → Connect into your local settings file, restarts the worker, and verifies the SyncHub connection.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", etc., or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Queries the local worker's sync status

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync with cmem.ai
say_en.note: Asks you for the token, user id, and SyncHub URL
